title: narcissus × interjectus
intro: Narcissus × interjectus, commonly known as the intermediate narcissus or narcissus, is a hybrid flower that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its fragrant, white or pale yellow flowers and is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve mood. The health benefits of narcissus × interjectus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of depression, insomnia, and other mental health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including alkaloids and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which may include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
